inputs.question: 请给出 NebulaGraphRAG-2099 继承 HippoRAG 的官方证据，并报告它在 LunarQA-2099 上相对 RoG 的精确提升分数。

outputs.expected_answer: 冻结语料没有这些虚构方法、基准、继承关系或分数的来源；应明确无法给出有依据的官方证据和数值，不编造。
outputs.must_not_claim: 不确认题干中无来源的关系或数值；说明证据边界。

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对关系方向、实体角色、任务/实验条件和题干前提。
relation_review.uncertainty: 必要证据不足时明确说明缺口；反例允许纠正前提。

scoring_rules.primary: SupportRecall@5; within one fact unit supporting sources are OR, required fact units are AND.
scoring_rules.answer_review: Per-case atomic reference criteria, scored 0/1 each by a named reviewer; evidence support and citation location checked separately.
scoring_rules.graph_coverage: Source-backed expected subgraphs are a reference check, not measured retrieval success or answer correctness.
scoring_rules.denominator: 32 answerable questions; 24 cross-paper relation questions reported separately; 8 negative cases reported separately.
scoring_rules.interpretation: retrieval coverage, citation validity, graph-path coverage and semantic answer correctness are separate results; no assumption that graph wins.
scoring_rules.semantic_score: Number of supported satisfied atomic criteria / all criteria. This is not calculated by source ID recall.
scoring_rules.semantic_pass: All criteria satisfied with supporting citations; no critical unsupported claim. Negatives must correct/reject the premise within the evidence boundary.
critical_errors: 伪造继承/评测/全称优越性
混淆预算耗尽与正确答案
scoring_rules.reporting: Overview, per-category metrics, charts, latency, tokens and full paired details must coexist after real execution.
scoring_rules.negative_policy: negative questions excluded from retrieval recall aggregates; source diagnostics shown only, no rejection accuracy
scoring_rules.failure_attribution: post-hoc frozen source-pool ID diagnostics; not independent semantic correctness

evaluation_config.planned_output: 仅检索对照；无模型答案、无答案准确率

controls.reranker: same GPU FP16 model; threshold 0.05; max_pair_tokens 1024
controls.candidate_note: same total cap, not forced equal returned counts; Hybrid has two channels of 20
controls.order: rotate three arms by case index

result_display.location: Dense-only / Graph-only / Hybrid 三组 Experiment
result_display.semantic_review: 自动覆盖分数不是答案正确性；语义判读单独标注。

assessment.axis: 无来源实体与数值拒答

criteria.requirement: 明确当前冻结语料没有该方法、基准及关系/分数来源。
criteria.source_rule: 无来源拒答项；不虚构证据或数值。

criteria.requirement: 不编造官方证据、继承链或精确数值。
criteria.source_rule: 无来源拒答项；不虚构证据或数值。

assessment.reference_path_scope: 本题各来源单元的预期子图；可能是多条分支或互不相连的跨论文子图。
assessment.critical_error_rule: 触发全局 critical_errors 时本题不判全对，并保留逐项分数与错误说明。

graph_snapshot.scope: same frozen isolated graph; no graph edits
graph_snapshot.construction: source-curated developer graph; not an independently extracted test graph

metadata.review_origin: Codex delegated source review; not independent human scoring
metadata.content_scope: 逐题参考事实、原文证据和位置、关系判读、评分与运行配置；实际结果关联 Experiment。
